platform: macOS aarch64 local JVM black-box fixture
trigger: a business interface declares Feign Core @RequestLine only on the method and has no class-level @FeignClient annotation
actual_pre_fix_behavior: the semantic overlay emitted no declarative_http_client_dispatch row for the annotated method; the independent validation oracle repeated the same class-only assumption and therefore accepted the omission
expected_behavior: OpenJDK reflection and javap both prove the runtime-visible method annotation, so the method must produce an exact declarative HTTP dispatch edge when the runtime handler is present
root_cause: both the producer and validation oracle gated client discovery on class annotations before inspecting member annotations
reproduction: Compile an interface whose call() method has runtime-visible feign.RequestLine and whose class has no FeignClient annotation.
Use JVM reflection and javap -v to establish the annotation independently of analyzer output.
Run the public binary pipeline with a Feign runtime handler and inspect the closed semantic overlay rows.
